title: auritus job list has no way to page past the first result
description:
Noticed while implementing auritus-7d8ffa. The admin \`GET /admin/jobs\`
route supports \`next_token\` pagination (and \`AuritusClient.list_jobs\`
already accepts it), but \`auritus job list\` never exposes a
\`--next-token\` option and never prints the \`next_token\` it gets back. An
operator with more jobs than the default page size has no way to see the
rest from the CLI.

Add \`--next-token\` to \`auritus job list\`, and print the returned
\`next_token\` (when present) so it can be passed to the next call.
